spans.s:
प्र-√ तुद् P. -तुदति, to strike at, cut through, pierce, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP. :
Caus. -तोदयति, to push on, urge, instigate, MBh.; Mṛcch.
प्र-˚तुद् m. ‘pecker’, N. of a class of birds (including the falcon, hawk, owl, parrot, crow, raven, peacock &c.), Āpast.
प्र-˚तुद m. id., Gaut.; Mn.; Yājñ.; Suśr.
an instrument for piercing, Suśr.
प्रा—तुद mfn. derived from the Pratudas or peckers (a kind of bird), Car.
प्रातृद &c. See under 3. प्रा, p. 702, col. 1.
See सु-प्रतु॑र्.
प्र-√ तुर्व् (only pr. p. -तू॑र्वत्), to be victorious, RV. v, 65, 4.

प्र-√ तुष् P. -तुष्यति, to delight in (instr.), Bhaṭṭ. :
Caus. -तोषयति, to give pleasure, gratify, BhP.
प्र-˚तुष्टि f. satisfaction (-द mfn. giving s˚), Pañcat.
प्र-˚तुष्टि—द mfn., giving s˚
See प्र-√ स्तु.
a kind of disease (causing pain of the nerves extending from the rectum and generative organs to the bowels; w.r. for प्रतितूणी?), Suśr.
˚तूर्त &c. See प्र-√ त्वर्.
प्र-˚तूर्ण mfn. quick, fleet, Hcar. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 61).
प्र-˚तूर्त (प्र॑-) mfn. id., ŚBr.
प्र-˚तूर्तक mfn. containing the word प्रतूर्त, g. गोषद्-आदि.
प्र॑-˚तूर्ति (प्र॑-), f. rapid or violent motion, haste, speed, RV.
प्र॑-˚तूर्ति mfn. hastening, rapid, violent, ib.; VS.
wishing to praise, W.
wishing to begin, MW.
